title: Optional easy 35min (ski week)
terrain: Before skiing or evening, flat or treadmill
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 35min at 138-150bpm if legs allow. Optional: skip if skiing hard.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal.
STOP RULE: quads sore from skiing = skip, no make-up.
WHY: Keeps the running pattern alive, nothing more.
